shared_case_surface: public-safe paired continuity capsule cases with one canonical baseline and exact portable and private materializations
bounded_replacement_rule: A local replacement may add capsule cases only when the canonical baseline, exact reference and digest binding, non-tail parity, portable tail omission, private verbatim tail posture, and explicit failure states remain visible.
public_safe_requirements: raw session transcripts, private host fingerprints, credentials, and runtime logs are not copied into the public bundle
the canonical capsule and both materializations keep exact owner, schema, object, and digest identity
portable materializations never contain protected-tail bytes
private materializations preserve the protected-tail digest and byte count
synthetic field preservation cannot be reported as runtime, semantic, economy, promotion, or owner-acceptance evidence
